rules: Same token text is not sufficient: namespace, issuing authority, entity type, actual value and effective interval must agree.
IMO ship numbers and IMO company numbers are separate.
Registration number requires registry and jurisdiction, not merely country name.
Person names require independent biographical identity; employer, address and family names are not ownership.
Local facility IDs require an official crosswalk; spatial nearest neighbor is provisional.
Country/year and product classes support aggregate comparisons, never named actor attribution.
Date fields constrain joins, they do not by themselves identify a record.
No compatibility dictionary entry verifies field presence, completeness or legal reuse.
